name: omarchy-asus plugin
author: omarchy-asus
description: One panel for an ASUS laptop's hardware on Omarchy, from omarchy-asus (ASUS fixes for Omarchy: https://omarchy-asus.github.io): keyboard and lid Slash LEDs; per-charger keyboard, refresh rate, screen backlight and CPU power limits; battery charge limit; Fn+Super. Sections hide when the laptop doesn't have them. Event-driven, one bundled Python bridge, nothing to install on stock Omarchy. Written on the ROG Zephyrus G16.

barWidget.description: ASUS laptop hardware in one panel: keyboard and Slash LEDs, per-charger refresh rate and power limits, charge limit, Fn+Super.
